How a Press works

Four buttons run the whole game.

X

Send a Press

Pick a move from the Sim's menu — or write your own — and set your coins. They lock into escrow the second you send.

A

She accepts

The Sim has 3 minutes to accept or skip. Skip it, and every coin comes straight back to you. No hard feelings, no charge.

▶

She plays it

Up to 20 minutes to do the move, live on camera, in front of the whole room. The room is the witness.

Y

You confirm

Tap Done within 15 minutes and escrow releases: 80% to the Sim, 20% house cut. Silence for 15 minutes pays her too — unless you open a dispute.

How a payout splits

Every completed Press pays out of escrow the moment you confirm — or when the confirm window runs out with no dispute:

80% to the Sim · 20% house cut. A 150-coin Press pays her 120 and keeps 30. A skipped or blocked Press pays nobody — you get all of it back.

Become a Sim

Your profile, your menu, your limits. You set what you will and won't do — the game enforces it.

Letters, numbers, underscores. This — not your phone number — is your key.
Forgot your password? The reset link goes here. Lose your phone number and you still get in — number is never the key.

The Rulebook

Short, hard, and enforced by the game itself — not by vibes.

!Never playable

  • ✕No Press may pay anyone to hurt a person — no hits, no dares that injure, no "pranks" on strangers.
  • ✕Nothing illegal. If it's a crime off camera, it's banned on camera.
  • ✕No minors — not as Sims, not as Controllers, not in the room.
  • ✕No meeting up. Coins buy camera time and camera moves only — never a person, never a place.
  • ✕No personal info: no real names, addresses, phone numbers, or schools in a Press.
  • ✕No weapons, no drugs, no threats, no blackmail.

The composer screens every custom Press against this list before a single coin moves. A blocked Press costs nothing and is logged.

✓Always playable

  • ✓Anything on the Sim's own menu — she wrote it, she priced it.
  • ✓Custom Presses inside her will-do list: dances, songs, study sessions, cooking, shoutouts, games, dares that stay safe and legal.
  • ✓Adult moves between verified adults, on camera, where her menu allows them.
  • ✓Her will-NOT list outranks your coins. A skip is instant, final, and fully refunded.

Every Sim's card carries her own limits in writing. The menu is the contract.

≡A Press, step by step

  1. You write the Press and set the coins.
  2. The Rulebook screen checks it. Banned means blocked, free.
  3. Coins move from your balance into escrow — held, not spent.
  4. The Sim has 3 minutes: Accept (A) or Skip (B).
  5. Skip = full refund, instantly.
  6. Accept = she has 20 minutes to do it, live.
  7. Done = you tap Confirm (Y) within 15 minutes.
  8. No tap and no dispute in 15 minutes = she still gets paid.
  9. Escrow splits: 80% to the Sim, 20% house cut.
  10. The whole trail lands in your Coin Bank ledger.

§Disputes & accounts

Disputes. Open one inside the confirm window and the coins freeze — nobody gets paid while the house reviews the room recording. "She didn't do it" with tape to prove it means a full refund. Fake disputes burn your Controller level.

Payouts. Sims cash out coins at 10¢ each, minus nothing extra — the 20% was already taken at the split. First payout waits on the ID check.

Never locked out. A Sim account logs in with username + password, and a recovery email resets a forgotten password. Your phone number is never the key — lose the number, you still get in. On Telegram itself, keep two-step verification on with a recovery email, and stay signed in on one device; that's what carries a Telegram account through a lost number.

The front door. The Telegram channel and the @Controlwhobot bot are promotion and sign-up only — clean and public-safe. The game itself lives here, on The Sim's own floor, where the 18+ gate stands.

Controller sign in

Username + password. No phone number needed — if you ever lose your number, your recovery email gets you back in.
